name: Xiaomi-OCR-0

lineage.how_derived: Q-Mask text anchoring, OCR-centric continued pretraining on about 170M samples, then mixed-task RL with verifiable rewards

purpose: One 0.8B model for document parsing and OCR-centric understanding (VQA, key information extraction) instead of separate parser and reader models (card).

license.name: Apache-2.0 (card tag)
license.notes: Card metadata says apache-2.0; the HF repo has no LICENSE file and the GitHub licence was not read.

architecture.kind: vision-language, Qwen3.5-0.8B architecture (hybrid linear and full attention, 24 layers, 12-layer vision tower)

variants.notes: also Q6_K 0.63, BF16 1.52 GB, plus mmproj BF16 0.21 GB (community)

pc-12gb.variant: GGUF Q4_K_M or Q6_K plus mmproj (about 0.8 GB)
pc-12gb.notes: 0.8 GB against a VRAM budget of 9.6 GB (VRAM minus about 2.4 GB), KV cache not included

pc-16gb.variant: GGUF Q4_K_M or Q6_K plus mmproj (about 0.8 GB)
pc-16gb.notes: 0.8 GB against a VRAM budget of 13.6 GB (VRAM minus about 2.4 GB), KV cache not included

pc-24gb.variant: GGUF Q4_K_M or Q6_K plus mmproj (about 0.8 GB)
pc-24gb.notes: 0.8 GB against a VRAM budget of 21.6 GB (VRAM minus about 2.4 GB), KV cache not included

pc-32gb.variant: GGUF Q4_K_M or Q6_K plus mmproj (about 0.8 GB)
pc-32gb.notes: 0.8 GB against a VRAM budget of 29.6 GB (VRAM minus about 2.4 GB), KV cache not included

mac-16-24gb.variant: GGUF Q4_K_M or Q6_K plus mmproj (about 0.8 GB)
mac-16-24gb.notes: 0.8 GB against a GPU share of about 12 GB (KV cache not included)

mac-32gb.variant: GGUF Q4_K_M or Q6_K plus mmproj (about 0.8 GB)
mac-32gb.notes: 0.8 GB against a GPU share of about 22 GB (KV cache not included)

mac-64gb+.variant: GGUF Q4_K_M or Q6_K plus mmproj (about 0.8 GB)
mac-64gb+.notes: 0.8 GB against a GPU share of about 52 GB (KV cache not included)

engine_support.notes: Community GGUFs with an mmproj exist; the card points to them.

benchmarks.name: OCR-centric VQA mean (DocVQA 93.1, InfoVQA 75.1, ChartQA 84.6, OCRBench 84.6, TextVQA 78.6)

strengths: tops the 0.8B class on its own tables, ahead of OvisOCR2 96.58 and PaddleOCR-VL-1.6 96.33 on OmniDocBench v1.6
also answers questions and extracts key fields
weaknesses: understanding needs more parameters than parsing: the vendor's own 4B VQA teacher reaches 88.1 against 83.2
best_for: scans and phone photos of documents to Markdown on small hardware
soft.maturity: released 2026-09-29 with technical report arXiv 2609.36136; community GGUF and Ollama ports within two weeks

tona_fit.reason: 0.8B, Apache by tag, 0.5 GB quantized, claims the top of OmniDocBench v1.6 in the 0.8B class with robustness to warped and photographed pages. All numbers are the vendor's own; no German evidence.
blockers: no Tona module for the Qwen3.5-0.8B VLM path

open_questions: independent reproduction of the OmniDocBench v1.6 score

sources.note: linked from the card, not opened
